items.q: Dave Kline used to use the electrolyte bulb with tape on it. He used to do the taps with Ted Lewis...

ctx.x: About a seven, eight inch high.
Anything, a derby. Dave Kline used to use the electrolyte bulb with tape on it. He used to do the taps with Ted Lewis, a beautiful effect from the distance.
